ELIXIR_BONE.name: Elixir of Bone
ELIXIR_BONE.effect: Up to 2 faces become BONE (6 points)

ELIXIR_LEAF.name: Elixir of Leaf
ELIXIR_LEAF.lore: Smells like a forest after rain. Tastes like the forest.

ELIXIR_VOLT.name: Elixir of Volt
ELIXIR_VOLT.lore: Fizzy in the way that makes your hair stand up.

ELIXIR_METAL.name: Elixir of Metal
ELIXIR_METAL.lore: Contains iron. A lot of iron. All of it.

STRENGTH_TONIC.name: Strength Tonic
STRENGTH_TONIC.lore: Makes a face count for more. Faces love it.

WHETSTONE_OIL.name: Whetstone Oil
WHETSTONE_OIL.effect: SHARP rune on up to 2 faces
WHETSTONE_OIL.lore: Sharpens dice. Do not ask how.

SWARM_BREW.name: Swarm Brew
SWARM_BREW.effect: SWARM rune on up to 2 faces
SWARM_BREW.lore: Buzzing faintly. Something is breeding in there.

WILD_SPIRITS.name: Wild Spirits
WILD_SPIRITS.lore: A rainbow you can drink. It drinks back.

GLASS_DRAUGHT.name: Glass Draught
GLASS_DRAUGHT.lore: Beautiful, powerful and one bad roll from shattering.

IRON_DRAUGHT.name: Iron Draught
IRON_DRAUGHT.lore: Works best when you keep the die in your hand. Like a lucky coin, but heavier.

GRAVE_DUST.name: Grave Dust
GRAVE_DUST.lore: Scraped from a very old tombstone. The ghost is still waiting for it.

LIQUID_GOLD.name: Liquid Gold
LIQUID_GOLD.lore: Gold you can pour. Pour it on a face and wait for payday.

LUCKY_CLOVER.name: Lucky Clover
LUCKY_CLOVER.effect: LUCKY rune on up to 2 faces
LUCKY_CLOVER.lore: Four leaves, one wish, small print attached.

MIRROR_DRAUGHT.name: Mirror Draught
MIRROR_DRAUGHT.effect: Pick 2 faces: the second becomes a copy of the first
MIRROR_DRAUGHT.lore: Look into it and one face looks back. Then becomes the other.

HERMIT_BREW.name: Hermit's Brew
HERMIT_BREW.lore: Brewed by a hermit who never spent a coin. Doubles yours.
